<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/companys/{idOrCode}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates the Company with this `referenceId`, or updates it when it already exists, so a system that keeps its own companies can send each one without storing its Voucherly ID. Calling it twice with the same body leaves the same Company.

The join code is set only when the Company is created: the `joinCode` you pass is kept when no other Company has it, otherwise Voucherly generates one. An update never changes it, because your customers already use it. To change it, use Update a Company.

`metadata`, when passed, is the whole set of fields: a key you leave out is removed. Without `metadata` the saved fields stay.
